short_description: Automated three-tier invoice dunning workflow — sends friendly reminders, gentle nudges, and final notices via Gmail, logs everything to Google Sheets, and alerts your team on Slack when a payment escalates.
full_description:
Stop chasing invoices manually. The Invoice Dunning & Payment Reminder blueprint handles your entire collections follow-up process automatically.

When a Stripe invoice becomes past due, this Make.com scenario triggers instantly and routes it through a three-tier email sequence:
- Days 1–3: A friendly, branded reminder email
- Days 4–10: A polite but direct nudge
- Day 11+: A final notice with escalation warning

Every action is logged to Google Sheets for a complete audit trail. On the final notice, your team gets an instant Slack alert in #collections-alerts so nothing falls through the cracks.
features: Stripe webhook trigger — fires automatically when an invoice goes past due
Three-tier email sequence with distinct styles (friendly → nudge → final notice)
HTML email templates with inline CSS and responsive design
Google Sheets logging for full audit trail of all dunning actions
Slack notification on final notice with invoice details and payment link button
Configurable day thresholds to match your payment terms
Router-based branching — easy to add more tiers or custom logic
Works in Stripe test mode for safe experimentation
HMAC webhook verification support for production security
All connections reusable — one-click auth for Gmail, Sheets, and Slack
requirements: Make.com account (any paid plan supporting Webhooks, Gmail, Google Sheets, and Slack modules)
Google account (for Gmail sending and Google Sheets)
Slack workspace (optional, only needed for team notifications)

workflow_modules.schedule: Real-time — triggered by Stripe webhook events

reminder_tiers.label: Friendly Reminder
reminder_tiers.description: Light-touch, friendly tone. Reassures the customer and provides a single payment CTA.

reminder_tiers.label: Gentle Nudge
reminder_tiers.description: Polite but more direct. Notes the number of days overdue and encourages prompt payment.

reminder_tiers.label: Final Notice
reminder_tiers.description: Urgent red-themed email warning of escalation. Logs to Sheets and sends Slack alert to the team.
